items.title: How networking became the critical layer of AI
items.summary: Investing.com -- Networking is replacing raw computing power as the main constraint on artificial intelligence performance as AI systems grow larger and more complex, Citi analysts said following the second day of the Hot Chips conference.

items.title: Will Datacenter Momentum Keep Powering Coherent's Growth?

items.title: Optics Stocks Slide as AI Hardware Trade Cools: Applied Optoelectronics and Lumentum Fall 6%, Coherent Drops 5%
